_comment: 85 Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image) through ComfyUI's partner node - the PAID door for
start frames, wired and switched off like 76. Needs the Comfy account token the frontend
supplies after login; none on this box. Price 2026-09: about $0.045 (0.5K) / $0.067 (1K) /
$0.151 (4K) per image. Up to 14 reference images on model.images.image_1..14 (a DynamicCombo
under `model`, names style); resolution 1K/2K/4K; aspect 16:9 etc. Use ONLY under the hybrid
rule (§96.4): a scene's start frames, scored with hybrid_frame_test.py against the local
compositor (80 / 75) before any is adopted. Knobs: 21-23 refs, 1 prompt/seed/aspect/res.

inputs.prompt: A still frame from a live-action film: the woman of image 2 and the man of image 3 stand facing each other in the place of image 1, medium shot, natural light.
